Reachtruck driver - Echt - 
 €16.47 per hour - Logistics - 38 hour 
We are looking for motivated employees who want to work as a Reachtruck driver at Action in Echt. Are you interested? Read on! 
Within the distribution center you and the team are responsible for handling the pallets. The work is focused on the accurate processing and placement of pallets. It is important that the pallets are always ready at the pick locations on time. In addition to processing the pallets, there is also work at height. The rack height at Action can be from 0 meters to 10 meters high! With the OPT stack, you replace and arrange pallets according to height. You have a well-equipped reach truck, including a camera with a screen. You also work with a scan gun that scans the assignments. As a Reach truck driver, you report to the team management of the IPL department. 
You work an average of 38 hours a week. There are two shifts: the first starts at 06:00 hours and the second starts at 15:15 hours. The end times are flexible. Sometimes you work on Saturdays. On that day there is only a morning shift. Action works with a clock pass. In addition, it is mandatory to wear work shoes as a Reachtruck driver at Action. 
 Job Requirements 
 - At least 18 years old - You speak Polish, Slovak, Czech or good English - Approachable and accurate - You want to work for a longer period of time - Experience in working with a reachtruck is an advantage - Reachtruck certificate 
 Employment conditions 
 - Employment contract with Charlie works - Health Insurance - Possibility for organized accommodation - During the afternoon shift you will receive a free evening meal - Possibility to earn a performance bonus - Additional allowances: 125% between 20:00 and 24:00, and 150% between 00:00 and 06:00 - Coffee, tea and fruit The company you will be working for is a well-known retail chain: Action. As a Field Service Technician, you will work on the assembly, installation, and commissioning of machines at customer sites in the Netherlands and abroad.
